name: @kitora/editors
description: Kitora's editors: a Tiptap rich-text editor (compact toolbar, bubble menu, slash commands, mentions, links, tables, code blocks, images, markdown import and export), a markdown editor with live preview, and a CodeMirror 6 code editor, with shortcuts on the keyboard kit.

exports.name: LinkPolicy
exports.description: The href to store for what the user typed or what a document contains, or `null` when it must not become a link.

exports.name: HighlightToken
exports.description: One run of highlighted text: the text and the token class to paint it with (`null` = plain).

exports.name: ClassNameHighlighter
exports.description:
The editors kit's original highlighter shape: code in, one flat run of class-named tokens out, whose concatenated
`text` equals `code`. The language is a kit language id (`plaintext` when unknown). Still accepted wherever a
highlighter is (`HighlightedCode highlighter`, `highlightTokens`); `classNameHighlighter` turns one into the seam's
`Highlighter` for a `HighlighterProvider`.

exports.name: Highlighter
exports.description:
A highlighter the editors accept: Kitora's one highlighting seam (`Highlighter` from `@kitora/display/core`,
which a `HighlighterProvider` sets for every kit) or the original function shape.

exports.name: CodeFormatter
exports.description: Formats a document; answer the new text (or the same text when nothing changes).

exports.name: defaultFormatter
exports.description: The default formatter: pretty-prints valid JSON, leaves everything else alone.

exports.name: plainHighlighter
exports.description: The plain highlighter: the whole document as one uncoloured token.

exports.name: isMarkdownCommand
exports.description: Whether `id` is a markdown command id.

exports.name: isCodeCommand
exports.description: Whether `id` is a code command id.

exports.name: EDITOR_CATEGORY
exports.description: The category every editor command is listed under.

exports.description: One bindable editor command.

exports.name: RICH_TEXT_COMMANDS
exports.description: Rich-text commands (Tiptap). Marks and blocks the toolbar shows plus link, slash menu and export.

exports.name: RichTextCommandId
exports.description: Id of a rich-text editor command, a key of `RICH_TEXT_COMMANDS`.

exports.name: MARKDOWN_COMMANDS
exports.description: Markdown editor commands (textarea). Same keys as rich text where the meaning is the same.

exports.name: MarkdownCommandId
exports.description: Id of a markdown editor command, a key of `MARKDOWN_COMMANDS`.

exports.name: CODE_COMMANDS
exports.description: Code editor commands on top of CodeMirror's own keymap (which keeps undo, search, indent, comment).

exports.name: CodeCommandId
exports.description: Id of a code editor command, a key of `CODE_COMMANDS`.

exports.name: tokenClassName
exports.description: The class a token is drawn with: an engine's own class when it carries one, else its kind's (`null` = plain text).

exports.name: seamLanguage
exports.description: An editors language id or fence name as the seam's language: the fence name first (`tsx` stays tsx), else its kit id's.

exports.name: HLJS_CLASS_OF_KIND

exports.name: EDITORS_LANGUAGE

exports.name: isCodeLanguage

exports.name: languageFromName
exports.description: The language a fence name (```ts) or id names, case-insensitive; `plaintext` when unknown.

exports.name: languageFromFilename
exports.description: The language of a file by its extension (`src/app.tsx` → typescript); `plaintext` when unknown.

exports.name: CODE_LANGUAGES
exports.description: Languages the kit highlights.

exports.name: CodeLanguage
exports.description: Id of a language the kit highlights, one of `CODE_LANGUAGES`.

exports.name: LANGUAGE_INFO
exports.description: Picker labels and the names / extensions that resolve to each language.

exports.name: safeHref
exports.description:
The href to store for what the user typed, or `null` when it must not become a link.
`""` (cleared) is also `null`, which callers read as "remove the link".

exports.name: isSafeHref
exports.description: Whether a stored href may be rendered as a clickable link (the read-side twin of {@link safeHref}).

exports.name: SAFE_LINK_SCHEMES
exports.description: Schemes a link may carry. Relative and fragment links have no scheme and are allowed separately.

exports.name: nextMarkdownView
exports.description: The view after `view` in the write → split → preview cycle.

exports.name: insertTable
exports.description: Inserts the table template at the caret.

exports.name: insertImage
exports.description: Inserts an image with the URL selected.

exports.name: markdownEdit
exports.description: The edit a command makes, or `null` for commands that are not edits (the view switch).

exports.name: tabIndents
exports.description: Whether Tab at `state` should indent (inside a list item, or over several lines) rather than move focus.

exports.name: caretPosition

exports.signature: (value: string, offset: number) => { readonly line: number; readonly column: number; }

exports.name: MARKDOWN_VIEWS
exports.description: Where the preview sits.

exports.name: MarkdownView
exports.description: Markdown editor layout: source only, source beside preview, or preview only.

exports.description: Labels for the view switch.

exports.description: The table a toolbar click inserts.

exports.name: rankItems
exports.description: The items matching `query`, best match first; an empty query keeps every item in order.
exports.signature: <T extends Rankable>(items: readonly T[], query: string, limit?: number) => T[]

exports.name: Rankable
exports.description: What the ranker reads from an item.

exports.name: toggleWrap
exports.description:
Wraps the selection in `before`/`after` (bold: `**`), or unwraps it when it is already wrapped,
inside or just outside the selection. An empty selection inserts the pair with the caret between.
exports.signature: (state: TextState, before: string, after?: string) => TextState

exports.name: toggleLinePrefix
exports.description:
Toggles a block prefix (`"## "`, `"> "`, `"- "`, `"1. "`, `"- [ ] "`) on every line the
selection touches. If every line already has it, it is removed; otherwise any other block
prefix is replaced. `"1. "` numbers the lines in order.

exports.name: continueList
exports.description:
What Enter does at the caret inside a list item: continue the list (next number, an unchecked
box), or, on an empty item, end the list by clearing the marker. `null` means "not in a list,
let the textarea insert a plain newline".

exports.name: indentLines
exports.description: Indents (or, with `outdent`, unindents) every line the selection touches.

exports.name: insertText
exports.description: Inserts `text` over the selection, caret after it.

exports.name: textStats
exports.description: Counts for a status bar: words, characters, and minutes to read at 230 words a minute.
exports.signature: (text: string) => { readonly words: number; readonly characters: number; readonly readingMinutes: number; }

exports.name: TextState
exports.description: A textarea's text and selection (`start` ≤ `end`, both UTF-16 offsets).

props.name: value
props.description: The full text.

props.name: start
props.description: Selection start, as a UTF-16 offset into `value`.

props.name: end
props.description: Selection end, as a UTF-16 offset into `value`; equals `start` for a caret.

exports.name: INDENT
exports.description: The indent Tab adds to a line (two spaces: nested markdown lists need two or more).

exports.name: applyTextEdit
exports.description: Applies `next` to the textarea as one undoable edit and selects `next.start`–`next.end`.

exports.name: syncScrollRatio
exports.description: Scrolls `target` to the same proportional position `source` is at (the split view's scroll sync).

exports.name: textareaState

exports.name: dataUrlUploader
exports.description: The default uploader: reads the file as a data URL (no network, no storage; fine for demos and small images).

exports.name: imageFiles
exports.description: The image files among a paste's or drop's items.

exports.name: ImageUploader
exports.description: Stores an image and answers its URL. The host's adapter uploads to its storage; the default inlines a data URL.

exports.name: useCommandKey
exports.description: The current key of command `id`, following user rebinds; empty when unbound and on the server.

exports.name: useEditorCommands
exports.description:

its default keys, and routes each command to `run` when this editor holds focus. Returns the engine.
exports.signature: (manifest: { readonly [id: string]: EditorCommandInfo; }, root: () => HTMLElement | null, run: (id: string) => void) => Keyboard

exports.name: usePlatformKeyText
exports.description: A fixed binding (`Mod+Z`) as display text for the engine's platform; `""` until hydrated.

exports.name: CommandKey
exports.description: A command's current key: display text (`⌘B` / `Ctrl+B`) and the `aria-keyshortcuts` value.

exports.name: useControllable
exports.description: `[value, set]` where `value` is `controlled` when given, else the component's own state.
exports.signature: <T>(controlled: T | undefined, defaultValue: T, onChange?: (value: T) => void) => readonly [T, (next: T) => void]

exports.description: The markdown editor's state and behaviour, for any markup.

exports.name: CODE_SURFACE_CLASS
exports.description: The look of every code surface: mono 12px on a muted panel.

exports.name: CODE_TOKEN_CLASS
exports.description:
The token palette for highlight.js class names (the code editor's CodeMirror tags, the rich-text code block, and any
`ClassNameHighlighter`), as descendant selectors on a code container. Each class reads the same design-language
variable as its token kind in the display kit's `TOKEN_CLASS` (`--dk-code-<kind>`, the theme kit's `code` slot) with
the same fallbacks, so the code editor, a read-only block and every other code display look alike in every language.
